method: git clone --shared of the lane, detached at the freeze; one or more commits added inside the clone only; the frozen script invoked unmodified with HYAKU_SCRATCH set per run

refusal_paths.refusal: freeze-integrity over the manifest's declared keys
receipt exit side and control counts

findings.title: FREEZE is unauthenticated; FREEZE == REV accepted, so manifest + counters + 'pre-registered' receipts can be minted in one commit
findings.evidence: a5: FREEZE_INTEGRITY OK, FROZEN_UNCHANGED=1, no DECIDING_REFUSED, run entered the counters
findings.correction: hardcode FREEZE_SHA next to BASE; require FREEZE==FREEZE_SHA, FREEZE!=REV and is-ancestor(FREEZE,REV)

findings.title: freeze.json key set never compared to contract.frozen_paths; dropping a key hides a tampered C1 counter and the gate prints OK files=5
findings.correction: compare set(fr['files']) to set(contract['frozen_paths']) minus the manifest

findings.title: receipt existence read from the REV blob, receipt content grepped from the working tree; symlink (mode 120000) receipts and assume-unchanged both pass the whole gate
findings.evidence: a6 (blob size 20 = link target, gate cleared), a10b (1-byte blob + verdict in worktree, status clean), a10a (same tamper, no flag, refused dirty-tree)
findings.correction: require mode 100644 via git ls-tree, and grep 'git show REV:path' instead of the working-tree path

findings.title: controls-*.exit never read and n/m never bound to the CTL lines or contract.claims.C*.controls; exit=1 and 0/0 both pass
findings.correction: require exit blob == 0; require n == m == count of '^CTL ' lines == len(contract claims.CX.controls), and each named control present

findings.title: dirty-tree guard is plain git status (blind to index flags) and its OUTDIR exclusion is an unanchored prefix regex
findings.correction: audit git ls-files -v for non-H flags; use -uall; anchor the exclusion with a fixed-string full-line match

findings.title: second-invocation marker uses [ -e ] (follows symlinks) and OUTDIR emptiness is never required, so a dangling link defeats the one-invocation rule; the start stamp is then written through the link
findings.evidence: a12 (marker absent, gate cleared, marker still absent after the run); symlink write-through verified in symmech/
findings.correction: [ -e ] || [ -h ] for markers; refuse unless OUTDIR is empty

findings.title: FROZEN_UNCHANGED=0 is printed and then ignored: the run proceeds into the counters and consumes the single invocation after the drift is known
findings.evidence: b7 (FROZEN_UNCHANGED=0, no refusal, no-harm and counter receipts written)
findings.correction: emit DECIDING_REFUSED frozen-drift and exit 3 at the point of detection

findings.title: three duplicate authorities that agree today: hardcoded 15 vs contract.no_harm_monitors, hardcoded frozen path list vs contract.frozen_paths, contract.deciding_invocations never read
findings.evidence: cross-check printed from the freeze bytes; all values agree at 631cd64
findings.correction: derive all three from contract.json at REV

defences_confirmed_sound: receipt genuinely authored before the freeze
freeze-integrity over the manifest's declared keys (MISMATCH exits 1 -> refusal)

probe_answers.receipt_committed_before_freeze: refused (a7); defeated in the other direction because the freeze may be cut after the receipts exist (a5) and because ancestry tracks the path's last touching commit, not the bytes
probe_answers.empty_file_still_a_blob: 0 bytes refused (a3); a 1-byte blob passes the size arm and only dies at the working-tree grep (a4), which a10b then satisfies
probe_answers.dirty_file_matching_outdir_exclusion: no dirty file needed: an untracked sibling directory is excused (a11) and a tracked file can be dirtied invisibly (a10b)
probe_answers.frozen_stdout_mismatch_exit_0: not reachable: freeze-integrity MISMATCH exits 1 and is wired to the refusal (a1); line 66 prints FROZEN_UNCHANGED=0 and sets rc=1 but does not refuse (F7)
